summary:
For someone in Saint Kitts And Nevis, the three needs areas with the largest gaps are: mobility (0.30), energy (0.53), environment (0.57).
The three strongest areas are: work (0.76), safety (0.75), health (0.73).
Personal-agent suggestions: focus community-building energy on weakest categories; leverage strongest categories as sources of economic value to bring to the community.
